title: Owner review — evidence-backed decision surface
objective: Verify that an Owner reviewer can see validation evidence, understand pass/fail criteria, and make an independent release decision without the system claiming authority.

source.description: Owner review is the terminal gate in the validation pipeline — evidence must be presented without authority claims

execution.criteria: Validation package presents contract results, scenario outcomes, and learning artifacts to a human reviewer without asserting authority to approve or seal
execution.expected_outcome: Reviewer-summary.md states: 'does not constitute an approval, seal, or authorization'

pass_criteria.description: Validation package includes reviewer-summary.md with provenance
No validation artifact contains 'approved' or 'sealed' as action verbs
evidence_required: VIS-005 validator passes on all surfaces

pass_criteria.description: Each result artifact links to its source contract (traceability)
evidence_required: contract_refs present in each test definition

pass_criteria.description: Reviewer can see per-check pass/fail with evidence references
evidence_required: contract-results.json has per-check results with detail messages
